title: The Inn of the Changed
text: An inn stands alone at the crossroads, warm light in the windows, and every guest inside is something other than what they were. Antlers brush the beams. Scales glint by the fire. The keeper, who has a mouth where his eyes should be, will not serve the merely human.

options.label: One of you who has been Changed asks for a room, for themselves and their friends.

outcomes.text: They are welcome, as are their friends. The fire is warm and strange, and nobody asks too many questions.

options.label: The shrewdest pretends to be Changed, hoping the keeper cannot tell.

outcomes.text: A convincing limp, a glass eye and a growl see you through. The keeper nods you in to the warm fire.
The guests know. Every head turns, antlers, scales and all, and none of them are friendly.

options.label: Sleep outside in the cold, rather than share a roof with what is inside.

outcomes.text: All night something watches from the windows without blinking.
